title: Proxy Authorisation
description: Authorises a proxy to act on behalf of a testator — information gathering, communication, negotiation, or full decision-making. Includes consent record with cultural consent methods

id.description: Unique identifier for this proxy authorisation within the INHERIT document

delegateType.description: The type of entity being delegated authority. Determines which identity fields are required
delegateType.$comment: person: a human delegate (executor, solicitor, family member) — proxyPersonId is required. agent: an AI agent acting on behalf of the testator (Arthur, Operations AI) — agentId is required. organisation: a corporate entity acting as delegate (law firm, trust company) — proxyPersonId references the organisation's representative.

agentId.description: Identifier for the AI agent delegate. Required when delegateType is agent. Format is intentionally flexible to accommodate different agent identity schemes as they emerge

agentIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the agent

agentCapabilities.description: What the agent is permitted to do under this authorisation. The schema records the authorised capabilities; the application enforces whether they are exercised

authenticationMethod.description: How the delegate proves its identity when exercising this authorisation
authenticationMethod.$comment: api_key: authenticated via API key. oauth_token: authenticated via OAuth 2.0. verifiable_credential: W3C Verifiable Credential (VC Data Model 2.0). delegation_protocol: authenticated via a standards-body delegation protocol (OpenID Foundation or equivalent). mcp_session: authenticated via MCP session. human_verified: identity verified by a human (e.g. in-person identification).

proxyPersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the authorised proxy. Required when delegateType is person or organisation

proxyPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced proxy person

testatorPersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the testator granting the authorisation

testatorPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced testator person

scope.description: The scope of authority granted to the proxy
scope.$comment: full: proxy may act in all capacities. information_gathering: proxy may only gather information about the estate. communication: proxy may communicate with professionals and family on the testator's behalf. negotiation: proxy may negotiate with dealers, professionals, and other parties. decision_making: proxy may make binding decisions on the testator's behalf.

consentRecord.description: Record of the testator's consent to this proxy authorisation

dealerNegotiationPermitted.description: Whether the proxy is specifically authorised to negotiate with dealers and third parties interested in estate assets

startDate.description: Date from which the proxy authorisation is effective

expiryDate.description: Date on which the proxy authorisation expires, if time-limited

revocationDate.description: Date the proxy authorisation was revoked by the testator, if applicable

revocation.description: Structured revocation record — models revocation as a mechanism, not just a date
revocation.$comment: Cross-jurisdiction revocation requires knowing who revoked, under which jurisdiction's authority, and whether a challenge period applies

revocationJurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction's authority governs this revocation

challengePeriodDays.description: Number of days during which the revocation can be challenged

challengeDeadline.description: Final date by which a challenge must be filed

evidenceUrl.description: Link to the revocation document or court order

delegationType.description: The type of delegation — on-behalf-of preserves principal/agent distinction, impersonation collapses it
delegationType.$comment: OpenID Unfinished Digital Estate report; OAuth RFC 8693 act claim

delegationConstraints.description: Constraints limiting how this delegation may be exercised

requiresCoApproval.description: Whether another person must approve actions

coApproverPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced co approver person

activationTrigger.description: The condition that activates this delegation
activationTrigger.$comment: Sovrin guardianship: conditional delegation; MOSIP death registration; Google Inactive Account Manager uses inactivity-based delegation

activationVerificationMethod.description: Method used to verify that the activation condition has been met
activationVerificationMethod.$comment: MOSIP integrates with civil registration for death verification

activationVerifiedBy.description: Who verified the activation condition was met

activationVerifiedAt.description: When the activation condition was verified

subDelegation.description: Whether the delegate can re-delegate authority. Supports delegation chains (executor → solicitor → paralegal)
subDelegation.$comment: Delegation chains are a core requirement for digital estate access — executor → solicitor → paralegal

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the delegation chain (1 = delegate can appoint one sub-delegate)

credentialRef.description: URI pointing to an external delegation credential (W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0, OpenID Foundation, or other delegation protocol). Protocol-agnostic
credentialRef.$comment: When a delegation protocol standard is published, this field holds the credential URI

externalConsentRef.description: URI pointing to an external consent record (FHIR Consent resource, or any external consent management system)
externalConsentRef.$comment: FHIR R5 Consent resource reference. Generic — works with any consent system, not just FHIR.

healthcareRecordAccess.description: Whether this delegation includes authority to access the deceased's medical records. Relevant for FHIR integration and healthcare interoperability

auditTrailEnabled.description: Whether all actions taken by the proxy should be logged for audit purposes

auditLog.description: Structured log of delegation actions — complements the auditTrailEnabled boolean

notes.description: Free-text notes about this proxy authorisation
examples: Proxy is testator's daughter — authorised to liaise with Bonhams regarding the art collection
Revoked after family disagreement — replaced by new proxy authorisation

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

ConsentRecord.description: Record of the testator's consent to proxy authorisation. Supports formal, informal, and culturally appropriate consent methods

consentGiven.description: Whether the testator has given consent for the proxy to act on their behalf

consentMethod.description: The method by which consent was obtained
consentMethod.$comment: in_person_verbal: verbal consent given face to face. in_person_written: written consent signed in person. video_recorded: consent recorded via video. witnessed_verbal: verbal consent in the presence of witnesses. phone_recorded: consent given and recorded over the telephone. assumed_cultural_norm: consent assumed under cultural norms where explicit consent is not customary (e.g. eldest son acts for the family). Use with caution — document the cultural basis.

witnesses.description: Witnesses to the consent, if any

personId.description: Reference to the Person.id of the witness

role.description: The role or capacity in which the person witnessed the consent

witnessedDate.description: Date this person witnessed the consent

documentRef.description: Reference to a document recording the consent

examples: Consent given in the presence of solicitor and two family elders
